name: Functional programming language that transpiles to JS

mentions.name: Functional programming language that transpiles to JS
mentions.description: A functional programming language that transpiles to JavaScript, accompanied by a full language specification and supporting tooling. It is being designed with Claude Code as an experiment in AI-assisted "vibe coding", with nothing pushed to GitHub yet.
